text: The association of gout flare resolution with physical activity and sleep: a prospective remote-monitoring study. This study aimed to determine whether gout flare resolution is associated with physical activity and sleep. These findings were intended to inform the future development of a definition for flare resolution.

Relative efficacy of exercise prehabilitation interventions and their components: a systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials. Exercise is the most common approach to prehabilitation; the optimal exercise interventions to improve postoperative outcomes are unknown.

Effect of electrical impedance tomography-guided positive end-expiratory pressure optimisation on postoperative pulmonary complications in laparoscopic colorectal surgery: a randomised controlled trial. Pneumoperitoneum and steep Trendelenburg positioning during laparoscopic colorectal surgery promote atelectasis and increase the risk of postoperative pulmonary complications (PPCs). Electrical impedance tomography (EIT) enables individualised PEEP titration by visualising regional lung collapse, facilitating lung-protective ventilation. However, evidence of its effect on clinical PPCs remains limited.
